entries.description: reasonable grounds for suspecting that the person has committed or is committing an offence
entries.subject: reasonable grounds
entries.object: suspecting that the person has committed or is committing an offence

spans.text: - (1) A constable may arrest a person without a warrant if the constable has reasonable grounds for suspecting that the person has committed or is committing an offence.

entries.description: In relation to an offence not punishable by imprisonment
entries.subject: In relation
entries.object: an offence not punishable by imprisonment

spans.text: - (2) In relation to an offence not punishable by imprisonment, a constable may arrest a person under subsection (1) only if the constable is satisfied that it would not be in the interests of justice to delay the arrest in order to seek a warrant for the person's arrest.

entries.object: (1) only if the constable is satisfied that it would not be in the interests of justice to delay the arrest in order to seek a warrant for the person's arrest

spans.text: - (2) In relation to an offence not punishable by imprisonment, a constable may arrest a person under subsection (1) only if the constable is satisfied that it would not be in the interests of justice to delay the arrest in order to seek a warrant for the person's arrest.

entries.description: Without prejudice to the generality of subsection (2)

spans.text: - (3) Without prejudice to the generality of subsection (2), it would not be in the interests of justice to delay an arrest in order to seek a warrant if the constable reasonably believes that unless the person is arrested without delay the person will—

spans.text: - (3) Without prejudice to the generality of subsection (2), it would not be in the interests of justice to delay an arrest in order to seek a warrant if the constable reasonably believes that unless the person is arrested without delay the person will—

folded.id: reasonable grounds|for|suspecting that the person has committed or is committing an offence
folded.subject: reasonable grounds
folded.object: suspecting that the person has committed or is committing an offence

spans.text: - (1) A constable may arrest a person without a warrant if the constable has reasonable grounds for suspecting that the person has committed or is committing an offence.

folded.subject: reasonably practicable

spans.text: - (1) Where a person is arrested by a constable outwith a police station, a constable must take the person as quickly as is reasonably practicable to a police station.
